The six two-gene motifs of Netz, Melo & Milocco

Source: R/model.R
paper_motif.Rd

Motifs from Gjuvsland et al. (2007) and Hether & Hohenlohe (2014), with evolvable production rates `alpha`: 1: x1 -> x2; 2: x1 -| x2; 3: x1 -> x2, x2 -| x1; 4: x1 -| x2, x2 -| x1; 5: x1 -> x2, x2 -> x1; 6: no interactions.

Usage

paper_motif(k, theta = 5, gamma = 1, ...)

Arguments

k

Motif number, 1 to 6.

theta, gamma

Threshold and decay rate (paper: 5 and 1).

...

Passed to [grn()], e.g. `evolvable`.
